info.name: GabayBigkas learner read benchmark
info.description: Read-only learner workload. Run the Learner reads folder with Postman Performance Runner after provisioning a consenting-adult test learner and owned session. No provider or write route is called.

item.name: Learner reads
item.description: One iteration performs three authenticated GET requests. Do not include login or session creation in this performance folder.

exec: if (!loopback && (!approvedBaseUrl || baseUrl !== approvedBaseUrl)) throw new Error('Remote load requires an exact approvedBaseUrl match');
if (!/^https?:\/\/[^/?#]+$/i.test(baseUrl)) throw new Error('baseUrl must be an HTTP(S) origin without a path');
if (!pm.variables.get('sessionToken')) throw new Error('Set a private learner sessionToken');
if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(String(pm.variables.get('sessionId') || ''))) throw new Error('Set an owned UUID sessionId');
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Returned owned session ID matches fixture', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('sessionId')));
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Result session ID matches fixture', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().session_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('sessionId')));
